Name: More Battery and Resource Sources
Author: abroalmor
Description:
More Battery Pack Sources

Adds additional ways to obtain Battery Packs while keeping the vanilla methods intact.

Instead of relying entirely on Lightning Rods and other vanilla sources, you can purchase Battery Packs from Clint or craft them yourself using resources.

FEATURES

• Clint sells Battery Packs for 3,000g each.
• Adds a new crafting recipe for Battery Packs.
• Crafting recipe: 1 Iron Bar + 1 Refined Quartz + 5 Solar Essence → 1 Battery Pack.
• The crafting recipe is available immediately and requires no skill level or other unlock condition.
• All vanilla methods of obtaining Battery Packs remain unchanged.
• Simple and lightweight Content Patcher mod.

INSTALLATION

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install Content Patcher.
3. Download More Battery Pack Sources.
4. Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
5. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

REQUIREMENTS

• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
• Content Patcher 2.0.0 or later

COMPATIBILITY

This is a Content Patcher content pack.

Mods that also change Clint's shop inventory or Battery Pack crafting recipes may potentially conflict with this mod.

UNINSTALLATION

Simply remove the "More Battery Pack Sources" folder from your Mods folder.
